caption: The drawing depicts a single female figure standing, dressed in historical clothing. She wears a light brown or beige shawl draped over her shoulders and crossed at the front, covering a white garment underneath. Her skirt is long and dark gray, reaching the ground, and she wears flat shoes that are partially visible from beneath the skirt. Her head is covered with a bonnet that is gray with a wide, ruffled brim and a yellow lining. Her face is pale with circular pink cheeks, and she has small, delicate features. The figure holds a small green drawstring purse in her right hand, which hangs at her side. The background is plain, off-white, and unadorned, with no additional objects or context present. The artist's signature appears near the bottom right of the image.
title: Quaker Doll
